g.text: BCM70015: native MFD configuration, no target writes
Progressive MPEG-2 640×360 · 180 pictures · unscaled YUY2 · installed module and library unchanged
After OPEN / before START
FIXED_COLOUR 00108080
Two matching ten-word tuples · 20 logical register reads
First output: release → successful owned-copy Write
FIXED_COLOUR 00909070
Two matching ten-word tuples · 20 more logical reads
Other sampled fields matched the observed board profile at both stages:
MFD REV / closing REV = 00000050
SCL REV / closing REV = 00000080
FEEDER_CNTL = 00000000
DATA_MODE = 00000000
RANGE_EXP_REMAP = 00000108
SCL BVB_IN_STATUS = 00000000
TEST_MODE = 00000004: saturation on; BVB test / ACCEPT bits clear
All 180 delivered pictures match the frozen native capture; EOS, cleanup and resources pass.
Four complete sessions pass: baseline, recovery after the initial guard rejection, revised observer, MPEG-2 recovery.
Final independent H.264 recovery also matches its full frozen capture. The initial TEST0 guard stopped at read 6, before START.
The interstage colour change shows why the pre-START value is not a later restoration ticket.
Equal tuples are not atomicity, transport, clock, ownership, source-lease, routing or standalone-output certificates.
No pointer following, status clear, FIFO/command access, geometry, test-mode, clock or other target writes.
Measured prototype source a82c4356 · board-profile pins MFD50 / SCL80 / TEST4 are observations, not universal defaults.
